item.title: WBS Penguins open Canadian road trip with loss to Laval
item.description: The Wilkes-Barre/Scranton Penguins lost to the Laval Rocket 5-1 on Wednesday night at Place Bell.

item.title: Gerry McNamara focuses on NCAA tournament date with Duke, not open Syracuse job
item.description: GREENVILLE, S.C. — Given his strong ties to Syracuse and his recent success in transforming Siena into an NCAA Tournament team in just two seasons as head coach, Gerry McNamara is an obvious candidate to replace the recently fired Adrian Autry.

item.title: Luzerne County provides update on new voting machines, drop boxes
item.description: Luzerne County’s new voting system equipment is scheduled for delivery within the next few weeks, said county Election Director Emily Cook.

item.title: 96 Salem Twp. landowners complete historic 1,700-acre sale for major data center campus
item.description: SALEM TWP. — A group of 96 landowners in Salem Township was paid more than $500 million for approximately 1,700 acres by Blackstone QTS in what is being called one of the largest land aggregations for data centers in the country.

item.title: Dallas Twp. Board of Supervisors approves data center zoning amendment
item.description: DALLAS TWP. — The township board of supervisors approved a zoning amendment regulating data centers during a special meeting on Wednesday in the Dallas High School auditorium, despite pushback from residents who felt the ordinance wasn’t comprehensive enough.

item.title: Royals celebrate state title berth with pep rally
item.description: The Royals head to Hershey on Thursday to take their shot at a state championship.

item.title: Holy Redeemer girls basketball looks to make history in 3A state finals
item.description: The last time a Wyoming Valley Conference girls basketball team played for a PIAA state championship, the current arena wasn’t even there.

item.title: Editorial: Smile, more daylight hours are finally here
item.description: It ends today. No more watching the days get shorter, the temperatures get colder or the risk of serious snowstorms get higher. This is the eve of the spring equinox, after which we start to see the sun hang out a little longer each day, right up to the summer solstice and the longest day of the year.

item.title: David M. Drucker: Your average Democratic voter isn’t a left-winger
item.description: President Donald Trump has a habit of referring to Democrats as “radical-left lunatics.” The unfair pejorative aside, it turns out the typical Democratic voter isn’t even left-wing. Let that sink in.
